title: Future — Irregular Stems
description: Learn the irregular future stems: tendr-, dir-, pondr-, podr-, querr-, har-, sabr-, vendr-, saldr-.

vocabulary.example: Habré terminado antes de las diez.

vocabulary.source: I will know how to say
I will be able to help

grammar.title: Future — Irregular Stems
grammar.content:
Some of the most common Spanish verbs have irregular stems in the future tense, but they STILL use the same regular endings. The key ones to memorize:

- tener → tendr- (to have) → tendré, tendrás, tendrá, tendremos, tendréis, tendrán
- poner → pondr- (to put) → pondré, pondrás, pondrá, pondremos, pondréis, pondrán
- salir → saldr- (to leave) → saldré, saldrás, saldrá, saldremos, saldréis, saldrán
- poder → podr- (to be able to) → podré, podrás, podrá, podremos, podréis, podrán
- querer → querr- (to want) → querré, querrás, querrá, querremos, querréis, querrán
- decir → dir- (to say/tell) → diré, dirás, dirá, diremos, diréis, dirán
- hacer → har- (to do/make) → haré, harás, hará, haremos, haréis, harán
- saber → sab- (to know) → sabré, sabrás, sabrá, sabremos, sabréis, sabrán
- venir → vendr- (to come) → vendré, vendrás, vendrá, vendremos, vendréis, vendrán
- haber → habr- (to have — auxiliary) → habré, habrás, habrá, habremos, habréis, habrán

Mnemonic: 'Had My Dad Put Six Small Pear Trees In The Garden' — HABER, HACER, DECIR, PONER, SALIR, PODER, QUERER, SABER, TENER, VENIR.
examples: Tendré una reunión importante mañana. (I will have an important meeting tomorrow.)
No podré asistir a la fiesta. (I won't be able to attend the party.)
¿Qué me dirás? (What will you tell me?)
Ella vendrá con nosotros. (She will come with us.)
grammar.aid_note: Romanian irregular future stems work similarly — they change the stem before adding the future marker. Spanish irregulars are limited to about 12 common verbs, and they all drop the final vowel of the infinitive before adding -r.

pronunciation.title: Future Tense Irregular — Key Sounds
pronunciation.content:
Irregular future stems are the same as conditional, plus the future endings:

1. **tendré** = ten-DREH (I will have — stress on 'dreh', accent mark!)
2. **pondré** = pon-DREH (I will put — accent on 'dre')
3. **saldré** = sal-DREH (I will leave — accent on 'dre')
4. **podré** = po-DREH (I will be able — accent on 'dre')
5. **querré** = keh-DRREH (I will want — accent on 'dre')
6. **diré** = deh-DREH (I will say — accent on 'dre')
7. **haré** = ah-DREH (I will do — accent on 'dre')
8. **sabrán** = sa-BRAHN (they will know — accent on 'ahn')
9. **vendrán** = ben-DRAHN (they will come — accent on 'ahn')

Key difference from conditional:
- Future: stressed final syllable (-ré, -rás, -rá, -remos, -réis, -rán)
- Conditional: stressed penultimate syllable (-ría, -rías, -ría, -ríamos, -ríais, -rían)

The 'll' cluster doesn't appear in these forms, but in related vocabulary:
- **llamaré** = YAH-mah-reh (I will call — 'll' = 'y')

examples.source: po-DREH ah-yoo-DAR (I will be able to help)

pronunciation.title: Future Irregular Stems — Stress on the Ending
pronunciation.content:
Future tense irregular forms follow a predictable pattern:

1. **tendré** = ten-DREH (I will have) — stress on 'dreh'
2. **pondré** = pon-DREH (I will put) — stress on 'dreh'
3. **saldré** = sal-DREH (I will go out) — stress on 'dreh'
4. **podré** = poh-DREH (I will be able) — stress on 'dreh'
5. **querré** = kehr-REH (I will want) — stress on 'reh'
6. **diré** = dehr-REH (I will say) — stress on 'reh'
7. **haré** = ah-REH (I will do) — stress on 'reh'
8. **sabré** = sah-BREH (I will know) — stress on 'breh'
9. **vendré** = ben-DREH (I will come) — stress on 'dreh'
10. **habré** = ah-BREH (I will have — auxiliary) — stress on 'breh'

The stress pattern is the same for ALL future irregulars: the stress falls on the **last syllable** because of the accent marks (-é, -ás, -á, -emos, -éis, -án).

Note: The 'rr' in 'querré' is rolled/trilled — it's a strong 'r' sound.

pronunciation.title: Future Tense — Accent Marks on Every Form
pronunciation.content:
The future tense has accent marks on ALL conjugations, making stress very clear:

1. **tendré** = ten-DREH (I will have)
2. **tendrás** = ten-DRAHS (you will have) — stress on 'drah'
3. **tendrá** = ten-DREH (he/she will have) — accent on 'eh'
4. **tendremos** = ten-DREH-mohs (we will have) — stress on 'dreh'
5. **tendréis** = ten-DREH-eese (you all will have) — accent on 'eh'
6. **tendrán** = ten-DRAHN (they will have) — stress on 'drahn'

Key pattern: The accent marks on future forms (é, ás, á, emos, éis, án) make every form distinctly stressed on the last syllable.

The irregular stems are identical to conditional:
- tener → tendr- (I will have)
- decir → dir- (I will say) → diré = dehr-REH
- hacer → har- (I will do) → haré = ah-REH
- saber → sabr- (I will know) → sabré = sah-BREH

examples.source: ten-DREH (accent on 'eh' marks stress on last syllable)

exercises.question: What is the future of 'tener' for 'él/ella/usted'?
exercises.explanation: 'Tendrá' — tener has the irregular stem tendr- in the future: tendr + á = tendrá.

exercises.question: Complete: 'Mañana ____ (hacer) la compra en el supermercado.' (Tomorrow I will do the shopping.)
exercises.explanation: 'Haré' — hacer has the irregular stem har- in the future. 'Haré la compra' = I will do the shopping.

exercises.question: Complete: '¿____ (you) ____ (say) la verdad?' (Will you tell the truth?)
exercises.explanation: 'Dirás' — decir uses the irregular stem dir- in the future: dir + ás = dirás.

exercises.question: Complete: 'No ____ (you) ____ (be able to) venir.' (You won't be able to come.)
exercises.explanation: 'Podrás' — poder uses the irregular stem podr-: podr + ás = podrás.

exercises.question: Complete the future tense conjugation table for the irregular verb TENER:
exercises.explanation: TENER uses the irregular stem tendr- in the future: tendré, tendrás, tendrá, tendremos, tendréis, tendrán.

exercises.question: Complete: 'Ella ____ (venir) con nosotros mañana.' (She will come with us tomorrow.)
exercises.explanation: 'Vendrá' — venir uses the irregular stem vendr-: vendr + á = vendrá.
